target.title: fix(session-cost-usage): deduplicate pricingFingerprint by storing it…
target.body:
Fixes #99511

## Summary

Fix Issue #99511: the usage-cost cache stores the full `pricingFingerprint` string on every `UsageCostCacheFileEntry`, causing significant file-size bloat. Move the fingerprint to the cache-object level and remove it from per-file entries. Also fix the checkpoint path: the fingerprint is now assigned at the start of the refresh so every checkpoint write (including interrupted refreshes) carries a valid fingerprint and preserves forward progress.

## Real Behavior Proof

**Environment**: Linux, Node v22.23.1, pnpm 11.2.2, worktree SHA 255e2518de

### Key tests

```bash
$ pnpm test src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts -- -t "stores the pricing fingerprint once at the cache level"

 ✓ |infra| src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts (60 tests | 59 skipped)
     ✓ stores the pricing fingerprint once at the cache level, not per entry

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed | 59 skipped (60)
```

```bash
$ pnpm test src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts -- -t "keeps a checkpointed cache fresh after reload"

 ✓ |infra| src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts (60 tests | 59 skipped)
     ✓ keeps a checkpointed cache fresh after reload when the cache-level fingerprint is present

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed | 59 skipped (60)
```

### Pricing-change invalidation still works

```bash
$ pnpm test src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts -- -t "invalidates durable aggregate cache"

 ✓ |infra| src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts (60 tests | 56 skipped)
     ✓ invalidates durable aggregate cache when pricing config changes
     ✓ invalidates durable aggregate cache when gateway pricing cache changes

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  4 passed | 56 skipped (60)
```

### Real cache-file size comparison

# Run locally with a synthetic cache
$ node scripts/proof-usage-cache-size-comparison.mjs
Entries: 1000
V4 cache size: 408,829 bytes (0.39 MB)
V5 cache size: 271,966 bytes (0.26 MB)
Savings: 136,863 bytes (33.5%)
Fingerprint per entry overhead: 136,863 bytes
### Format / Lint

```bash
$ npx oxfmt --check src/infra/session-cost-usage.ts src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts
All matched files use the correct format.

$ npx oxlint@latest src/infra/session-cost-usage.ts src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts
Found 0 warnings and 0 errors.
```

## Regression Test Plan

- `stores the pricing fingerprint once at the cache level, not per entry` verifies the v5 cache shape.
- `keeps a checkpointed cache fresh after reload when the cache-level fingerprint is present` verifies that a checkpointed cache is not treated as stale after reload (ClawSweeper P1 feedback).
- `invalidates durable aggregate cache when pricing config changes` / `...gateway pricing cache changes` verify pricing-change invalidation/rebuild.
- `fills every calendar day... DST transition` also fails on clean `main` and is unrelated.

## Root Cause

In `src/infra/session-cost-usage.ts`, `scanUsageFileForCache()` writes `pricingFingerprint` into every `UsageCostCacheFileEntry`. The fingerprint is a normalized pricing table for the whole config, so it is byte-identical across all entries for a given config, resulting in massive duplication.

Additionally, `refreshCostUsageCacheForPath()` originally assigned the top-level `pricingFingerprint` only during the final write, so checkpoint writes inside the loop did not include it. An interrupted large refresh would therefore produce a checkpointed cache with no fingerprint, causing the next load to treat every entry as stale and discard the checkpoint progress.

## Implementation Plan Details

1. Add `pricingFingerprint?: string` to the `UsageCostCacheFile` type.
2. Remove `pricingFingerprint` from the `UsageCostCacheFileEntry` type.
3. Preserve top-level `pricingFingerprint` in `normalizeUsageCostCache()`.
4. In `refreshCostUsageCacheForPath()`:
   - If the cached top-level `pricingFingerprint` differs from the current config fingerprint, clear all live entries (they are stale under the new pricing).
   - Set `cache.pricingFingerprint = pricingFingerprint` at the start of the refresh, so every checkpoint and final write carries it.
5. Change `isUsageCostCacheEntryFresh()` and `canUseUsageCostCacheEntryForPartial()` to compare `cache.pricingFingerprint`.
6. Remove `pricingFingerprint` from `scanUsageFileForCache()` and from returned entries.
7. Bump `USAGE_COST_CACHE_VERSION` from 4 to 5.

## Change Details

- `src/infra/session-cost-usage.ts`
  - `USAGE_COST_CACHE_VERSION`: 4 → 5
  - `UsageCostCacheFile`: add `pricingFingerprint?: string`
  - `UsageCostCacheFileEntry`: remove `pricingFingerprint: string`
  - `normalizeUsageCostCache()`: keep top-level `pricingFingerprint`
  - `refreshCostUsageCacheForPath()`: clear cache on pricing change; set top-level fingerprint before any write, including checkpoints
  - `isUsageCostCacheEntryFresh()` / `canUseUsageCostCacheEntryForPartial()`: compare `cache.pricingFingerprint`
  - `scanUsageFileForCache()`: no longer writes `pricingFingerprint` into entries
  - Update call sites to pass `cache`
  - Add comments explaining non-obvious changes
- `src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts`
  - Add `stores the pricing fingerprint once at the cache level, not per entry`
  - Add `keeps a checkpointed cache fresh after reload when the cache-level fingerprint is present`

## Test Points

- `pnpm test src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts -- -t "stores the pricing fingerprint once at the cache level"` passes
- `pnpm test src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts -- -t "keeps a checkpointed cache fresh after reload"` passes
- `pnpm test src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts -- -t "invalidates durable aggregate cache"` passes
- `npx oxfmt --check src/infra/session-cost-usage.ts src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts` passes
- `npx oxlint@latest src/infra/session-cost-usage.ts src/infra/session-cost-usage.test.ts` passes


## Related

- Issue: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99511
